findings.message: Overlay increases food/cooking rows in the profile preview.

limitations: This PoC does not install or enable a product overlay.

Light accepted labels are included with lower membership in the artifact, but are not injected into profile_topics because current profile-bootstrap scoring consumes topic presence rather than scalar membership.
The result proves reviewed-label integration for the current frontier; it does not solve food/cooking recall.

methodology.overlay_application: Accepted review labels are injected into seed metadata as profile_topics, then existing profile-bootstrap reranking is run for a diagnostic food profile. Only strong rows are injected; light rows remain in the overlay artifact.

findings.message: Accepted food/cooking review labels produced overlay rows.
All review rows have decision labels.
